description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Blasting Station and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Skeleton and/or Rogue you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
